crisis.title: If you need to talk right now
crisis.abroad: If your life is in danger, call the emergency number (police or ambulance) of the country where you live.

gate.suspended: This account can't be used right now. Please contact us through the contact form.
gate.notAdmin: Only the samasama team can use this page.

noPersonalInfo.title: What we don't keep
noPersonalInfo.body: We only ask for a nickname, your age, where you live and your language. We don't keep your name, phone number, address, gender or date of birth. There is no password.

whoSees.title: Who sees what
whoSees.body: Supporters see only your nickname, your area and what you wrote. Requests about life, violence and those from people under 18 go only to organizations we have interviewed.

onlyChosen.title: Only to people you choose
onlyChosen.body: We pass your nickname and what you wrote to a nearby service only when you choose "OK to share".

records.title: How records are kept
records.body: When a request is solved, the samasama team keeps a short summary of the situation, what was done and what happened next (names and contact details are hidden). Supporters' contribution records belong to them and are deleted if they leave.

roles.title: One account
roles.body: You can ask for help and support others with the same account. To become a supporter, you also agree to the rules for supporters and organizations.

providers.title: Companies we use
providers.body: We use companies outside Japan, such as Cloudflare, Supabase and AI providers (Google, OpenAI, xAI). Before anything is sent to AI, we hide what looks like names and contact details.

consent.agree: I agree to the points above, the terms of use and the privacy policy
consent.error: We couldn't save this. Please try again.
consent.updatedLead: Please check what has changed before you continue.

profile.displayNameHint: (doesn't have to be your real name)

start.loginTitle: How would you like to continue?
start.loginTip: There is no password. Next time, sign in the same way. Your email is used only for signing in and is never shown to supporters.
start.sendCodeNote: Enter the code you receive to continue.
start.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a little and try again.
start.sendFailed: We couldn't send it. Please wait a little and try again.
start.codeWrong: The code is wrong or has expired. Please send a new one.
start.linkAlsoWorks: You can also tap the link in the email.
start.profileTitle: Just tell us a nickname and where you live
start.profileTipLabel: What we ask and what we don't
start.profileTip: We don't ask for your name, phone number, address, gender or date of birth. All contact happens inside this app. Your area is used to find services near you. Your age goes up by one each year from today.
start.agreeRequired: You need to agree to continue
start.saveFailed: We couldn't save this. Please try again.
start.callbackFailed: We couldn't complete the sign-in. Please try again.

me.title: Me
me.notificationsTip: If you share your device with family, we recommend leaving these off. Even when on, we never put the content of your request in the subject or the message. The email subject is only "A notice from samasama".
me.emailNote: Only tells you that an offer or message has arrived
me.pushNote: Available when you add the app to your home screen (coming soon)
me.withdrawTip: Requests that are open or in progress will be cancelled. If you have supported others, all your contribution records will be deleted too.
me.withdrawConfirm: This can't be undone. Do you really want to delete your account?
me.withdrawLastOwner: You are the manager of an organization. Please make someone else the manager first.
me.withdrawFailed: We couldn't delete your account. Please contact us through the contact form.
me.loginMethodsTip: If you lose access to both, contact the samasama team and we can switch your sign-in method.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.lead: Let the samasama team know if you have questions, if your request isn't moving, or if you have trouble with a supporter.
contact.name: Name
contact.loggedInNote: We'll reply to the email address of the account you're signed in with.
contact.required: Please fill in the required fields
contact.failed: We couldn't send it. Please try again.
contact.doneBody: The samasama team will read it and reply by email if needed.
